messages:
acme_app_team: Hey — after yesterday's refactor our tool calls to `translate_v2` started failing in prod with a 400 `tool_not_found`. Calls to `translateV2` succeed. Did the tool get renamed?

sam_supp: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the original request body and the exact error payload? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

acme_app_team: Hosted. Request body (we only changed client library):
```json
{
  "tool": "translate_v2",
  "args": { "text": "hello", "target": "es" }
}
```
Error: `{"error":"tool_not_found","message":"tool 'translate_v2' not found for model-route 'gpt-4-infer'"}`

maria_eng: Thanks. Two quick guesses: alias removed during rename OR registry sync lag between control plane and serving runtime. Can you run this repro curl to show server-side error id?
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"translate_v2","args":{"text":"hi","target":"fr"}}' -i
```

acme_app_team: Ran it — got `x-request-id: req_9f2a1b` and backend returned the same `tool_not_found` with `registry_version: 2027-03-02T01:22:10Z` in the response metadata.

kevin_platform: Pinging registry-bot for last sync windows. @registry-bot show last sync for hosted-us-west and diffs for tool names.

registry-bot: sync_job: hosted-us-west last_run=2027-03-02T01:20:05Z, completed=true, processed=1243 tools. Note: normalized name mapping contains `translateV2` but no `translate_v2`. Diff detected: renamed `translate_v2` -> `translateV2` (case + underscore).

maria_eng: Confirmed — control plane has the new canonical name `translateV2`. The runtime uses normalized IDs and should accept aliases, but alias for `translate_v2` was not created in this rollout (pipeline bug).

sam_supp: Short-term mitigation: we can create an alias mapping so old clients keep working. I'm going to add alias `translate_v2` -> `translateV2` on the customer's route. Doing now.

maria_eng: Runbook for ops to add alias via API:
```bash
POST /v1/tool-registry/aliases
{
  "route": "acme-app-route",
  "alias": "translate_v2",
  "target": "translateV2",
  "reason": "rollback compatibility for rename rollout"
}
```

kevin_platform: Alias created and propagated to hosted-us-west at 2027-03-02T01:27:12Z. Please retry.

acme_app_team: Retried — success! No code change required on our side. Thanks.

maria_eng: Root cause: rename pipeline failed to emit alias objects for underscore->camel renames in 2.3.1 deploy. Action items: 1) patch pipeline to auto-generate aliases for safe renames, 2) add a preflight check that verifies aliases exist before cutting traffic, 3) add metric alert if registry/routing divergence > 30s.

sam_supp: Logged internal ticket INF-2478 and assigned to eng-runtime; sent customer summary and ETA for permanent fix.

acme_app_team: Appreciate the quick fix. Can you add a note to changelog so we know about future renames?

kevin_platform: Will add to customer-facing changelog and notify via console banner for any rename rollouts for the next 7 days. :thumbsup:

maria_eng: Closing thread after follow-up verification. If anything else pops up, re-open and ping me.

acme_app_team: All good — thanks everyone! :pray:
